# Feedback Triage Log

A lightweight log to track what the community needs and what we're building. The
disposition convention (did / won't / later) is defined in
[weekly-rhythm.md](../weekly-rhythm.md).

| Item | Source | Disposition (did / won't / later) | Roadmap link | Note |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| <Summary of request or pain point> | <Player / Discord message> | <did / won't / later> | <link to roadmap item> | <brief, kind context on the decision> |
| _Example: auto-assign basic roles on join_ | _@PlayerName in the community Discord_ | _later_ | _<roadmap link>_ | _Good idea to save GM clicks; paused until the core is stable._ |
